text:
Jules: Heads up — seeing a burst of ALB target deregistrations in eu-west-1 since ~10:22 UTC. Targets report HEALTHCHECK_FAILED / timeout even though pod readiness shows Ready. Not sure if this is ALB or node-level networking. :thinking:
Arjun: Any conntrack alerts? sounds like NAT exhaustion from previous similar incidents.
Marta: Yep, got a spike alert on nodepool-gpu-edge-1: nf_conntrack table usage jumped to 99% around the same time. Logs show 'nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet'.
Kai: ALB logs attached to the monitor show 503 -> target timed out, target deregistered after 3 failed checks. Health check config is default (interval 10s, timeout 5s, unhealthy threshold 2).
infra-monitor: [ALB] deregistration event: target i-0a1b2c3d removed from tg-xyz at 2026-11-04T10:23:57Z (reason: Unhealthy)
deploy-bot: Recent deploys? none in last 30m on that cluster. Canary rollouts: none.
Jules: Pods are responding to kubectl exec curl localhost:8080 fine. Readiness probe status is 1/1. This smells like egress path (NAT) or conntrack causing incomplete TCP handshakes to ALB health check.
Marta: quick checks i ran:
```
# on node
sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count
# => 199988
sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max
# => 200000
dmesg | tail -n 20
# => nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```
Arjun: If conntrack is overflowing, ephemeral ports / NAT translations fail and ALB health probes will never complete. We saw identical symptoms when a single customer had huge egress fanout last month.
Kai: Can we mitigate quickly? options: increase nf_conntrack_max, add more NAT gateways, or reduce health check strictness temporarily.
Marta: I'm for immediate increase of nf_conntrack_max to 500k on affected nodepool and rolling-restart daemonset to apply sysctl. Also open ticket to scale our NAT pool.
Jules: Agreed. Also let's tweak ALB healthcheck timeout to 8s and unhealthy threshold to 3 while we stabilize so we don't churn targets. We'll revert after root cause.
Arjun: I'll submit the TF change to nat-gateway counts and post PR.
Kai: I'll patch the ALB healthcheck via console for the target group (manual quick fix).
deploy-bot: Patch applied to tg-xyz: healthcheck timeout=8s, unhealthy_threshold=3 by Kai at 2026-11-04T10:38:02Z.
Marta: sysctl bump applied to nodepool-gpu-edge-1 (nf_conntrack_max=500000), rolling restart started via daemonset. Conntrack table dropping decreased within 60s.
infra-monitor: conntrack_count -> 120432 on nodepool-gpu-edge-1 after restart. ALB target re-registrations began ~10:42 UTC.
Jules: Good recovery. Follow-ups: 1) permanent increase + tf change to set netfilter sysctl at node bootstrap, 2) autoscale NAT gateway counts by egress risk, 3) add alert for conntrack usage > 80% instead of current 95%, 4) postmortem with traffic correlation to customer job. I'll create incident doc and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
